raw_response: {"diagnosis":"silver_transactions sums raw amount without regard to currency, so the 83 EUR rows are counted as USD. raw_fx_rates has a EUR rate (1.25, GBP is 1.5), so the fix is to convert amounts to USD in silver, and the gold tables inherit it.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.8,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(t.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, t.customer_id, CAST(t.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(ROUND(CAST(t.amount AS DOUBLE) * f.rate_to_usd, 2) AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions t LEFT JOIN raw_fx_rates f ON f.currency = t.currency WHERE t.status = 'POSTED'"}}
